text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 15: Plant information lowers a shared model's error; the clipping ceiling does not help unseen plants'
text.tspan: Figure 15: Plant information lowers a shared model's error; the clipping
ceiling does not help unseen plants

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in error of a shared XGBoost model given plant information, compared with the same model given none (G-B0), in percentage points of capacity; more negative is better. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a seed. Each row label gives the two models' mean absolute errors (% of capacity). Orange: the scored plant was in training. Purple: the scored plant was left out of training, an unseen plant. With the clipping ceiling (G-FP) the gain is 0.40 points for seen plants and 0.17 for unseen plants; without it (G-FPnoCK) the gains are 0.31 and 0.32.'

text.font-family: Matter Semi Mono, Roboto Mono, monospace
Matter Semi Mono, Roboto Mono, monospace

text.aria-label: Title text 'The fingerprint (G-FP) describes each plant by its transfer ratio (TF), clipping ceiling (CK), and daily shape. G-FPnoCK is G-FP without CK, and G-ID+TF is a plant code and TF. Lead-day 1 is the forecast for the day after the day it is issued. G-ID, G-FP, G-L1, LOPO G-FP, and LOPO G-L1 are exploratory (the first run). G-ID+TF, G-FPnoCK, and LOPO G-FPnoCK are post hoc, written after the first run's results were known. Arms. G-B0: one global XGBoost model with no plant information. G-ID: one global model given a plant code. G-L1: one global model given L1. G-FP: one global model given the plant's TF, CK, and daily shape (a fingerprint). LOPO: leave one plant out, meaning the scored plant is left out of training. TF: the 30-day ratio of power to forecast irradiance (the transfer ratio). CK: the plant's clipping ceiling.'
text.tspan: The fingerprint (G-FP) describes each plant by its transfer ratio (TF), clipping ceiling (CK), and daily shape. G-FPnoCK is
G-FP without CK, and G-ID+TF is a plant code and TF. Lead-day 1 is the forecast for the day after the day it is issued.
G-ID, G-FP, G-L1, LOPO G-FP, and LOPO G-L1 are exploratory (the first run). G-ID+TF, G-FPnoCK, and LOPO G-FPnoCK are post
hoc, written after the first run's results were known.
Arms. G-B0: one global XGBoost model with no plant information. G-ID: one global model given a plant code. G-L1: one global
model given L1. G-FP: one global model given the plant's TF, CK, and daily shape (a fingerprint). LOPO: leave one plant out,
meaning the scored plant is left out of training. TF: the 30-day ratio of power to forecast irradiance (the transfer ratio).
